lines.text: We would like to run workshops for our regional managers this autumn.
lines.name: Priya

lines.text: The budget we have approved is 15000 for the whole programme.
lines.name: Priya

lines.text: That is workable. How many sessions are you thinking of?
3 workshops, each one half a day, with about 20 people.
lines.name: Priya

lines.text: Can we record the sessions for the people who cannot join?
lines.name: Priya

lines.text: Recording changes how open people are, I want to think about it before I answer.
I will send you a draft agenda for all three workshops by next Tuesday.
Perfect. We also need a room that fits twenty people.
lines.name: Priya

lines.text: I will book the room in the main office and send you the address.
lines.name: Priya

lines.text: Thank you. Do you want the workshops in the same week or spread out?
Spread out, one workshop each Tuesday, so people can do the homework between sessions.
lines.name: Priya

lines.text: Then we are set for now.
lines.name: Priya
